metrics.label: Dodgers international signings
metrics.definition: All Dodgers-franchise signing records in DISI (tracked, opening-class census and outcome-selected historical records)
metrics.eligibility_rule: Every Dodgers signing; populations are labelled, never pooled into a rate

metrics.label: Outcome-selected historical signings
metrics.definition: Dodgers signings recorded because they became notable
metrics.eligibility_rule: Excluded from every rate, distribution and training population

metrics.label: Verified MLB players
metrics.definition: Dodgers signings with an audited MLB debut
metrics.eligibility_rule: Unaudited signings are unknown, never failures; a count, not a rate

metrics.label: Known acquisition spend
metrics.definition: Sum of KNOWN acquisition-cost components (bonus, posting, transfer, release, other) of Dodgers signings
metrics.eligibility_rule: A lower bound while spend_state = KNOWN_SPEND_IS_A_LOWER_BOUND; unknown cost is never $0; pool charges are not acquisition cost

metrics.label: Realized organizational value
metrics.definition: Regular-season bWAR the Dodgers obtained: direct Dodgers bWAR + individually attributable (sole-outgoing-asset) trade-return bWAR
metrics.eligibility_rule: Resolved values only (realized_value_state REALIZED_TO_DATE / TO_DATE_CHAIN_INCOMPLETE); package and observable-not-attributable value never added; bWAR only

metrics.label: MLB value produced for other clubs
metrics.definition: MLB bWAR of Dodgers signings in non-Dodgers team-seasons
metrics.eligibility_rule: Not Dodgers organizational value; reported separately

metrics.label: Supported outcome targets
metrics.definition: Outcome targets whose reference population meets the 50 / 10 / 10 support minimum
metrics.eligibility_rule: Support rule fixed in outcome_targets; populations never pooled

metrics.label: Published player probabilities
metrics.definition: Player x target probabilities that are not NULL
metrics.eligibility_rule: Only eligible, open-outcome Dodgers amateur rows of a supported population

metrics.label: Supported expected organizational values
metrics.definition: Player expected values that are not NULL
metrics.eligibility_rule: Requires a supported 041 probability AND a supported conditional value

metrics.label: Predictive portfolio recommendations
metrics.definition: Candidates eligible for value-based portfolio optimization
metrics.eligibility_rule: Requires a supported expected value, complete cost and complete signing-time features

metrics.label: Open research tasks
metrics.definition: Open items in the DISI research queue
